text:
Type: rectangular seagrass storage baskets, pair
Use: organizing small items, magazines or toiletries on a shelf; living room, bathroom, bedroom, home office
Style: coastal, Scandinavian, Japandi
Materials: woven seagrass, cotton fabric binding around the rim and base
Colors: light natural straw, off-white trim
Shape: open-top rectangular boxes with straight sides, fine vertical weave, fabric-bound edges, compact and light
Feel: natural, tidy, calm, warm
Goes with: light wood shelves, white walls, linen, green plants; coastal, Scandinavian or Japandi rooms
